components.name: Gion Machiya Heritage Boutique Hotel (Check-in)
components.description: Restored 120-year-old traditional cedar townhouse with modern acoustic insulation and private rock garden.

components.name: Scenic Sagano Romantic Scenic Railway
components.description: Open-air vintage diesel locomotive tracing the Hozugawa River ravine during peak foliage.

components.name: Hozugawa Traditional River Boat Descent
components.description: 16km river navigation steered with bamboo poles through roaring gorges and tranquil pools.

components.name: Riverside Kaiseki Lunch at Arashiyama Waterfront
components.description: Handmade yudofu tofu tasting menu overlooking the mist rising over Mount Ogura.

components.name: Private Tenryu-ji Sogenchi Garden Meditation Session
components.description: Early-morning entrance before general gates open. Guided breathwork and historic iconography lecture.

components.name: Alpine Panoramic Chalet & Spa (Check-in)
components.description: Direct views of the North Face of the Eiger with Finnish outdoor heated thermal pools.

components.name: Eiger Express Tricable Gondola Flight
components.description: High-speed 3S cableway climbing 1,400 meters in 15 minutes straight to the Eiger Glacier station.

components.name: Jungfraujoch Top of Europe & Ice Palace Discovery
components.description: Highest railway station in Europe at 3,454m with guided glacier walking and Ice Palace tunnel.

components.name: Fort Kochi Heritage Walk & Chinese Fishing Nets
components.description: Guided walking tour of Dutch palaces, Jewish synagogues, Chinese fishing nets, and colonial spice warehouses.

components.name: Traditional Kerala Sadhya Feast
components.description: Authentic 18-course Kerala Sadhya served on fresh banana leaf with rice, curries, pickles, and payasam dessert.

components.name: Private Kettuvallam Houseboat — Alleppey Backwaters
components.description: Two-bedroom rice-barge with a private sundeck, onboard cook, and scenic sunset anchorage in the Vembanad lake network.

components.name: Munnar Tea Estate Sunrise Walk & Plantation Stay
components.description: Colonial-era planter's bungalow set among 200 acres of rolling tea gardens with guided sunrise harvest walk.

components.name: Periyar Tiger Reserve Wildlife Canoe Safari
components.description: Silent bamboo canoe through the core wildlife zone — elephants, sambar deer, and rare Malabar giant squirrels at dawn.

components.name: Kathakali Performance & Kalaripayattu Martial Arts Demo
components.description: Backstage makeup session followed by live Kathakali performance and a Kalaripayattu demonstration by student masters.

disruptions.description: Unseasonal snowfall at Rohtang Pass above 3,900m closed the approach road. Operator rerouted group to Solang Valley extended paragliding and glacier viewing as a high-value alternative.

components.name: Bhuntar Airport Transfer — Old Manali
components.description: Premium 4WD pickup with luggage handling through the scenic Beas River valley gorge road.

components.name: Himalayan Riverside Camp & Log Cabin Check-in
components.description: Riverside log cabins with mountain views, bonfire evenings, and farm-fresh breakfast from local dairies.

components.name: Solang Valley Paragliding & Zorbing Adventure
components.description: Tandem paragliding from 2,480m with panoramic views of the Dhauladhar Range, followed by snowball zorbing.

components.name: Rohtang Pass 4WD Expedition — Lahaul Valley
components.description: Private 4WD to the 3,978m Rohtang summit, continuing into the stark moonscape of Lahaul Spiti.

components.name: Hampta Pass Trek — Day Ascent
components.description: Moderate ascent through alpine meadows to 4,268m. Dramatic contrast of lush Kullu valley and arid Lahaul on either side.

components.name: Hadimba Temple & Vashisht Hot Springs Morning
components.description: Visit the 1553 Hadimba wooden temple in its deodar cedar grove, then soak in the ancient sulfur hot springs at Vashisht village.

title: 4-Day Amalfi Coast — Clifftop Villages & Azure Waters

components.name: Le Sirenuse Positano Check-in & Terrace Welcome
components.description: Five-star cliffside hotel with ceramic-tiled balconies directly overlooking the Tyrrhenian Sea.

components.name: Private Speedboat Grotto Blu & Capri Excursion
components.description: Private 8-passenger mahogany speedboat visiting the Emerald Grotto, Capri's Blue Grotto, and Faraglioni sea stacks.

components.name: Ravello Villa Rufolo Gardens & Concert
components.description: Private garden access at Villa Rufolo with guided Wagner history tour and a sunset classical concert on the famous belvedere stage.

components.name: Limoncello & Pasta Masterclass — Conca dei Marini
components.description: Hands-on limoncello distillation with Amalfi lemons, followed by pasta-making and a 3-course dinner with Campanian wine pairing.

components.name: Path of the Gods Hiking Trail — Nocelle to Positano
components.description: The legendary 7.8km coastal cliff trail from Nocelle with panoramic sea views, descending directly into Positano for farewell lunch.
